name: Fermat's Library
text:
Visualization of the Dzhanibekov Effect onboard the International Space Station. 😳The effect is named after the Russian cosmonaut Vladimir Dzhanibekov who discovered this phenomenon while in space in 1985.

Find an explanation of the physics here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Si6iRL5Fj8&feature=youtu.be
